A7 Dispatch Queue DB Migration (Phase 1 dual-write):
1. Add v14 schema to db-manager.ts: dispatch_queue, dispatch_context, dispatch_prompt_refs, dispatch_attempts tables with indexes
2. Create lib/dispatch-db.ts: CRUD helpers for dispatch_queue operations (enqueue, dequeue with lease, consume, get prompt refs)
3. Modify dispatch-subagent.ts: After prompt generation, INSERT into dispatch_queue + dispatch_prompt_refs; keep existing .pending.json write
4. Modify task-before.ts: After DISPATCH-INTEGRITY check, attempt DB lease; fallback to .pending.json read if DB empty/error
5. Modify task-after.ts: On successful dispatch, UPDATE dispatch_queue status to 'consumed'; INSERT into dispatch_context + dispatch_attempts
6. Keep file fallback read-only (not removed yet)
7. Run framework-self-test to verify no regressions
